scope: local matched research-model compute diagnostic, not production/browser CTV
cold_fit: all loaded source-module LRU caches cleared; compiler already warm
warm_fit: preceding per-case fit available; path cache cleared
concurrent_load: Parent confirmed no full GARCH/panel run active; only other agents metadata and source tests
output_parity_scope: Each model has identical full path and loss bytes across its six repeats (three cleared-fit and three warm-fit) per case; models intentionally have different forecast laws; no implementation changed
paired_uncertainty_note: Only three paired observations per case and cache stratum. Exact enumeration of27 paired bootstrap resamples gives descriptive median-ratio percentile intervals; too few repetitions for reliable tail or general-workload inference.
